info.title: Proposed FCR Payment Discovery Inquiry
info.description: Proposed distinct exact-reference and dated-list requests for the user-built inquiry API. The server URL is a reserved documentation placeholder. Bank authentication and any FLEXCUBE framework envelope remain to be agreed. Both operations return discovery observations, not full payment evidence or an outcome.

servers.description: Documentation placeholder; configure the real endpoint privately

post.summary: Find scoped transactions by exact reference or selected calendar date

200.description: Completed discovery. Return all host rows for each retained payment. Exact lookup must return only matches to the requested bank/branch and reference, hasMore=false, with all matching payment groups within the 200-payment/2000-row safety bounds. Otherwise return an error. Dated list grouping and recordCount apply to payments, not joined rows.

400.description: Invalid request shape, reference, date, bank, branch or record limit

403.description: Caller is not authorized for this branch/bank scope

503.description: Inquiry could not complete; do not return an empty successful list

reference.description: Exact text reference in the selected namespace and authorized bank/branch. No date or record-count field is accepted.

orgBank.description: Requested bank code. ESAF example 760; other banks use configured codes. Server must authorize the bank/branch pair.

orgBranch.description: Requested branch within server-authorized bank and deployment scope

inquiryDate.description: Selected source-local calendar day; the UI defaults to today. Not an implicit seven-day range.

recordCount.description: Maximum distinct payment identities, preserving their relevant host subsequences

hasMore.description: Additional matching payments exist beyond this bounded result. No partial host group is permitted.

REF_SUBSEQ_NO.description: Required column; null or empty string means unknown. Known values remain exact integer strings. Never replace unknown with zero.

UTR_REF_NO.description: Empty string when not assigned; never invent a UTR

DATINITIATION.description: Source-local timestamp. Oracle DATE carries no timezone; do not append an invented Z.

NUMAMOUNT_4038.description: Exact nonnegative source decimal; preserve precision, no exponent notation or rounding

CURRENCY.description: Optional ISO code from a verified installed mapping

DIRECTION.description: Optional mapped direction, not an unverified raw code
